chip_specification.application: Continuous Heart Rate (PPG), Hemodynamic Pulse Waveform, and Acute Cardiac Troponin Biomarker Transducer

synthesized_nanostructure.fill_fraction_definition: Linear duty cycle: 68.35% (w/Lambda); 2D square pillar area fraction: 46.72% (w^2/Lambda^2)

manufacturing_and_biocompatibility.causal_robustness_definition: Judea Pearl Counterfactual Battery: Verified under do(w +/- 10nm CD bias), do(theta = 30 deg), and do(sidewall = 88 deg)
manufacturing_and_biocompatibility.photothermal_safety: Temperature rise under 200.0 W/cm² is 0.0°C (Peak: 25.0°C). Structure is thermally stable.
manufacturing_and_biocompatibility.biochemical_functionalization: Refractometric transduction surface; requires Anti-cTnI antibody immobilization (Step 6 of Cleanroom Recipe) for selective Troponin-I capture
